Description - GET /repo/beta/

Not verified live. Link "download beta version" shown in the UI (http://bts.box.%1/repo/beta/), opened in the browser. It is a web page, not part of the automatic update flow (see getUpdateRepository).

Security notes - findings that concern GET /repo/beta/

  • C-07 High (requires a network position) Updates come over plain HTTP and are applied with administrator rights, protected only by an unauthenticated hash: each package is checked by SHA-1 against the sha1 attribute of packages.xml, which comes over the same channel without any verification (no signature, no key; a mismatch is called "Signature error"), and installer.exe runs package commands without any prior check. Anyone who can alter the traffic (hostile network, DNS, proxy) can supply a matching manifest and package that runs elevated. The repository answered 404/403 on 2026-10-24, but a network attacker does not need the real server.

From x-security-notes in the spec. Ratings and scope are explained on Security & privacy.
